consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the 1987-12-31 show at Oakland Coliseum was a high-energy performance with standout moments, particularly in the first set. The collaboration with the Neville Brothers added to the excitement, and several songs were highlighted as exceptional.
rating_rationale: 2.5 base + 0.3 for 37 reviews + 0.5 sentiment: While many fans praised the energy and specific performances, there were also criticisms regarding the overall quality and some songs being overrated.
